_title: Lab 3: Descriptive statistics (mean, median, mode, histograms)

criteria.code: Each task attempted, runs without error, uses the required functions, and its printed output matches expected_outputs.json.
criteria.explanation: Markdown or comment explanation covers the reference concepts for tasks that ask to explain.
criteria.documentation: Headings or comments label each task; outputs are shown; no stale errors.

tasks.T1: For data = [1, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9, 2] compute the mean by hand (sum / n) and with the statistics module.
tasks.T2: Plot a histogram of data, and a histogram of 200 values drawn from a normal distribution with mean 100 and standard deviation 10.
tasks.T3: Compute the median of data by sorting (odd and even n), and check with statistics.median.
tasks.T4: Find the mode of [1, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9, 1, 7]. It has two modes.
